greeting.text: A heavily bearded dwarf crouches over a bubbling pot, stirring slowly. He squints up at you. 'Aye, mysterious stew this is. Ancient recipe. Cost me a pretty coin to make.' He taps the ladle on the rim. 'Few coins for ingredients and there's a bowl in it for ye.'

choices.text: Hand over some coins for a bowl.

eat.text: The dwarf grins through his beard and ladles out a steaming bowl. It smells of herbs and something you can't quite place. Warm, hearty — you feel better for it.

decline.text: The dwarf shrugs and turns back to his pot. 'Suit yerself.' The smell follows you down the corridor.
